description: Search active, worldwide-remote, non-partner job listings. Returns up to 20 summarized rows (no full description). Jobs that are region-locked away from Indonesia are excluded by default; every row carries `indonesiaEligibility` (id_friendly | restricted | unknown) plus the raw `geoFit`/`applicantRegion` it was derived from.

freshness.description: fresh | active | stale_risk (W5 tier; omit for no filter).

include_region_locked.description: Default false. When true, also return jobs restricted to a region an Indonesia-based applicant cannot work from (geo_fit = restricted, or applicant_region in US/UK/EU/Canada/North America). Check each row's `indonesiaEligibility` before recommending one.

remote_usd_only.description: Only worldwide-remote jobs paid in USD.

name: search_jobs
title: Search remote jobs
